mechanism: Zscore=(close−rolling_mean)/rolling_std over z_period; enter long/short at extreme thresholds (e.g. ±2), exit nearer 0; half-life HL=−log(2)/λ from OLS of Δp on lagged p (Ornstein–Uhlenbeck)—short HL and λ<0 endorse mean-reversion; OOS warns thresholds need dynamism.
data_needed: Closes; z_period; Long/Short open/close levels; OLS for λ
